source_text: De Aoth et Samegar et Iabin et Sisara. Aoth sinistra manu percussit Eglon — sermo Dei anceps gladius. Samegar sexcentos Philisthinos stimulo boum.
pass_a_gloss: Concerning Ehud and Shamgar and Jabin and Sisera. Ehud with-left hand struck Eglon — word of-God double-edged sword. Shamgar six-hundred Philistines with-goad of-oxen.
pass_b_english: On Ehud, Shamgar, Jabin, and Sisera. [[Ehud with the left hand struck Eglon >> Bible:Judges 3:15-22]] — God’s word a [[two-edged sword >> Bible:Hebrews 4:12]]. [[Shamgar struck six hundred Philistines with an ox-goad >> Bible:Judges 3:31]].
notes: True OET; no copyrighted Judges FOTC.
